messages:
jordan_customer: Hey — we just hit the monthly quota reset but our app still gets 429s on generation calls. UI shows 10,000 credits for org, but API returns 429s since 00:05 UTC. Anyone seen this?

alex_support: Hey @jordan_customer — sorry about that. Can you paste the tenant/org id and a curl of the /v1/usage or /v1/credits response? Also which key are you hitting (project vs org key)?

jordan_customer: tenant: acme-inc-42, project key: proj_live_9. I ran:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer proj_live_9" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/credits
```

Response: `{"credits_available":0,"next_refill":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}` even though console shows 10000.

alex_support: Hm thanks. Console showing org-level bucket maybe but project-level quota could be separate. Tagging @maria_engineer for quota sync check. :eyes:

maria_engineer: Looking. At 00:00 UTC the billing service emitted a refill event for org `acme-inc-42` but I see a partial refill for `proj_live_9` in the event log (only +2000) — could be proration after recent plan change. Any plan change around Feb 28?

jordan_customer: We upgraded to Pro on Feb 27 afternoon. Billing UI said prorated credit applied. We expected full monthly bucket on Mar 1.

alex_support: That could explain partial. But the API showed zero. Can you post the raw `GET /v1/projects/proj_live_9/credits` output? Also does `GET /v1/orgs/acme-inc-42/credits` show 10000?

jordan_customer: Org call:
```
{"org_id":"acme-inc-42","credits_available":10000,"last_refill":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}
```
Project call:
```
{"project_id":"proj_live_9","credits_available":0,"last_refill":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","prorated":true}
```

maria_engineer: OK that matches. Looks like billing created an org-level bucket but project bucket remained at 0 and flagged `prorated`. There are two possibilities: 1) UI aggregated org+project and displayed org total to your view, or 2) a cache inconsistency between billing and quota service after upgrade. I'll pull logs. @ops_sre can you check the quota service sync for proj_live_9?

ops_sre: Checking. I see the quota service received a `refill` for project at 00:00 but the worker errored when writing to Redis (`ERR write timeout`) and retried. Retry completed at 00:04 but a separate job reapplied a negative adjustment (old stale snapshot) at 00:05, zeroing the project bucket. Likely a race between the billing refill job and the snapshot replay.

alex_support: So that would explain API 429s — project bucket ended up 0 despite org bucket being 10k. We need to correct project bucket and avoid replaying stale snapshots. Maria, can you apply a manual fix and add a compensating refill for proj_live_9?

maria_engineer: I can. I'll issue a compensating refill of +10000 to proj_live_9 and mark the stale snapshot as superseded so it won't replay. Doing that now.

billing-bot: [billing-event] applied manual_adjustment to proj_live_9 +10000 by maria_engineer at 2026-03-01T00:12:03Z

jordan_customer: Thanks — after a few retries our calls are succeeding again. Curious though: how can we prevent this from happening again? We do heavy bursting at midnight during daily reports.

maria_engineer: Two mitigations: 1) we can pin project-level refill to occur earlier (e.g., 23:50 UTC) to avoid high-retry windows; 2) we will harden the snapshot replay ordering so refills take precedence and stale snapshot replays are rejected if older than refill timestamp. We'll create a postmortem and a follow-up.

alex_support: Also if you expect burst at reset, we can temporarily allocate a short-term top-up (burst credit) or increase project commit for that cycle. Happy to coordinate with your account manager. :thumbsup:

jordan_customer: Appreciate it. Leaving this here in case others hit similar confusions — org-level UI can mask per-project deficits when you use project keys.

maria_engineer: Filing follow-up ticket: QUOTA-4578 — ensure refill atomicity and prevent stale-snapshot reapply.

ops_sre: Adding monitoring alert to detect project-level negative drift after refill window.

alex_support: Closing loop: manual fix applied, customer confirms success, eng/ops working follow-ups. If anything else pops up ping me. :rocket:
